rationale: AVAV has already made its large intraday move (gapped +4.24%, ran to $159.24), and is now 3.39% off the high in a declining-volume consolidation near the 9-EMA — the easy directional money appears spent. The 5-minute ATR of $0.34 is extremely compressed relative to the stock's intraday range, making stop placement mechanically awkward and risk/reward poorly defined in either direction. With the broader market under pressure (-0.48% SPY) and no clear re-acceleration signal from price action, the probability of a clean tradeable leg is insufficient to justify capital deployment.
